views.name: Step 1
views.caption: Unplug the USB cable from the Nano Board at the top of the I/O module, and lift its other end off the table.

views.name: Step 1c
views.caption: Unplug the USB cable from the Nano Board at the top of the I/O module, and lift its other end off the table.

views.name: Step 2
views.caption: Swing the top of H14 out from over H11 and H12, then lift its two bottom tabs off the top edge of the dot matrix display.

views.name: Step 2c
views.caption: Swing the top of H14 out from over H11 and H12, then lift its two bottom tabs off the top edge of the dot matrix display.

views.name: Step 3
views.caption: Tilt the top of the dot matrix display forward, then lift it up off the hooks of H11 and H12 and hold it in front of them. Leave its wires connected.

views.name: Step 3c
views.caption: Tilt the top of the dot matrix display forward, then lift it up off the hooks of H11 and H12 and hold it in front of them. Leave its wires connected.

views.name: Step 4
views.caption: Lift the dot matrix display back over the case and set it on the table behind it.

views.name: Step 4c
views.caption: Lift the dot matrix display back over the case and set it on the table behind it.

views.name: Step 5
views.caption: Tilt the 4-digit display forward off H13, then lift it out of the notches in H11 and H12 and hold it over the gap between them. Leave its wires connected.

views.name: Step 5c
views.caption: Tilt the 4-digit display forward off H13, then lift it out of the notches in H11 and H12 and hold it over the gap between them. Leave its wires connected.

views.name: Step 6
views.caption: Carry the 4-digit display back over the top of the case and down behind it, out under the dot matrix display's wires, to the table.

views.name: Step 6c
views.caption: Carry the 4-digit display back over the top of the case and down behind it, out under the dot matrix display's wires, to the table.

views.name: Step 7
views.caption: Lift the I/O module straight up off the back of H4, its edges out of the notches in the tabs of H10, and hold it over H4.

views.name: Step 7c
views.caption: Lift the I/O module straight up off the back of H4, its edges out of the notches in the tabs of H10, and hold it over H4.

views.name: Step 8
views.caption: Set the I/O module down on the table behind the case, with everything still plugged into it.

views.name: Step 8c
views.caption: Set the I/O module down on the table behind the case, with everything still plugged into it.

views.name: Step 9
views.caption: Slide H13 up from between H11 and H12, bringing its hooks out of H4.

views.name: Step 9c
views.caption: Slide H13 up from between H11 and H12, bringing its hooks out of H4.

views.name: Step 10
views.caption: Slide H12 forward until it comes out of H4, then lift it out of the slot in H10.

views.name: Step 10c
views.caption: Slide H12 forward until it comes out of H4, then lift it out of the slot in H10.

views.name: Step 11
views.caption: Slide H11 forward until it comes out of H4, then lift it out of the slot in H10.

views.name: Step 11c
views.caption: Slide H11 forward until it comes out of H4, then lift it out of the slot in H10.

views.name: Step 12
views.caption: Lift the front of H10 off H2 and H3, then unhook its rear tabs from the slots in H4.

views.name: Step 12c
views.caption: Lift the front of H10 off H2 and H3, then unhook its rear tabs from the slots in H4.

views.name: Step 13
views.caption: Slide all four piano keys (H9) out of the slots in H4 and back through H8 to the front.

views.name: Step 13c
views.caption: Slide all four piano keys (H9) out of the slots in H4 and back through H8 to the front.

views.name: Step 14
views.caption: Pull H8 up out of the slots in H5.

views.name: Step 14c
views.caption: Pull H8 up out of the slots in H5.

views.name: Step 15
views.caption: Turn the case over. Swing H7 up out of the notches in H3, then unhook its tabs from the windows in H2.

views.name: Step 15c
views.caption: Turn the case over. Swing H7 up out of the notches in H3, then unhook its tabs from the windows in H2.

views.name: Step 16
views.caption: Press the four push buttons out of their pockets in H6 and set them on the table beside the I/O module. Leave their wires connected.

views.name: Step 16c
views.caption: Press the four push buttons out of their pockets in H6 and set them on the table beside the I/O module. Leave their wires connected.

views.name: Step 17
views.caption: Pull the dot matrix display off the ends of its five wires.

views.name: Step 17c
views.caption: Pull the dot matrix display off the ends of its five wires.

views.name: Step 18
views.caption: Pull the 4-digit display off the ends of its four wires.

views.name: Step 18c
views.caption: Pull the 4-digit display off the ends of its four wires.

views.name: Step 19
views.caption: Pull the four push buttons off the ends of their wires.

views.name: Step 19c
views.caption: Pull the four push buttons off the ends of their wires.

views.name: Step 20
views.caption: Unplug all 21 breadboard wires from the I/O module.

views.name: Step 20c
views.caption: Unplug all 21 breadboard wires from the I/O module.

views.name: Step 21
views.caption: Lift the Nano Board out of the I/O module.

views.name: Step 21c
views.caption: Lift the Nano Board out of the I/O module.

views.name: Step 22
views.caption: With the case still upside down, swing H6 up out of the notches in H3, then unhook its tabs from the windows in H2.

views.name: Step 22c
views.caption: With the case still upside down, swing H6 up out of the notches in H3, then unhook its tabs from the windows in H2.

views.name: Step 23
views.caption: Swing H5 up out of the notches in H3, then unhook its tabs from the windows in H2.

views.name: Step 23c
views.caption: Swing H5 up out of the notches in H3, then unhook its tabs from the windows in H2.

views.name: Step 24
views.caption: Turn the case the right way up. Pull H4 off the back tabs of H2 and H3.

views.name: Step 24c
views.caption: Turn the case the right way up. Pull H4 off the back tabs of H2 and H3.

views.name: Step 25
views.caption: Pull H3 off the end of H1.

views.name: Step 25c
views.caption: Pull H3 off the end of H1.

views.name: Step 26
views.caption: Pull the front tabs of H2 out of the slots at the other end of H1.

views.name: Step 26c
views.caption: Pull the front tabs of H2 out of the slots at the other end of H1.
